candidates.description: This feature vector represents autonomous or semi-autonomous mechanical and robotic systems.
This feature vector represents computational technology, programming, and systematic methods.
This vector represents quantitative or qualitative modifiers indicating plurality, variety, or significance.
This vector represents French possessive determiners and related morphological variations.
This feature vector represents names, brands, or titles associated with vehicles, machines, and science fiction or action characters.
This vector activates strongly for tokens containing the letter sequence "ot," particularly within bot- and pilot-related words.
This vector represents the character sequence 'aut' and its common morphological extensions in multiple languages.
Common French grammatical words and frequent functional terms.
Common prefixes used to modify base words and create descriptive compound terms.
This vector represents common French adverbial words used to modify verbs, adjectives, or clauses regarding time, degree, or manner.
